_meta.indication: RIVFLOZA is indicated to lower urinary oxalate levels in children 2 years of age and older and adults with primary hyperoxaluria type 1 (PH1) and relatively preserved kidney function, e.g., eGFR \ge 30 mL/min/1.73 m2.

pivotal_trials.phase: Adequate and well-controlled (registrational) randomized placebo-controlled trial
pivotal_trials.design: 6-month, parallel-group, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial that randomized participants 2:1 to nedosiran or placebo (adaptive randomization).
pivotal_trials.population: Pediatric and adult patients aged 9 to 46 years with PH1 or PH2 and an eGFR \ge 30 mL/min/1.73 m2; only PH1 supported the indication.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Area under the curve, from Days 90 to 180, of the percent change from baseline in 24-hour urinary oxalate excretion (AUC24-hour Uox).
pivotal_trials.result: LS mean AUC24-hour Uox -3486 (95% CI: -5025, -1947) RIVFLOZA vs 1490 (95% CI: 781, 3761) placebo; between-group difference 4976 (95% CI: 2803, 7149; p<0.0001). Among PH1 patients the between-group difference in percent change was 56% (95% CI: 33%, 80%).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (\ge20%) are injection site reactions, reported in 7 patients with PH1 (39%) on RIVFLOZA vs no patients on placebo; included erythema, pain, bruising, and rash, generally mild.
target_moa: Nedosiran is an LDHA-directed siRNA that reduces hepatic lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) via RNA-interference degradation of LDHA mRNA in hepatocytes (GalNAc-mediated delivery), thereby reducing hepatic oxalate production.

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held; the application did not raise significant issues requiring external expert advice.

description.text: Expanded PH1 indication to include children 2 to <9 years of age

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for an expansion of the currently approved indication to lower urinary oxalate levels in children 9 years of age and older and adults with primary hyperoxaluria type 1 (PH1) and relatively preserved kidney function, e.g., eGFR \ge 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, to children 2 to <9 years of age.

orphan_indication.text: FDA granted nedosiran orphan drug designation on May 15, 2018 for the treatment of PH (primary hyperoxaluria).

citations.quote: On May 15, 2018, FDA granted nedosiran orphan drug designation (designation request number DRU-2018-6354) for the treatment of PH; therefore, the product is exempt from Pediatric Research Equity Act requirements for the indication.

summary.text: This was a standard-review NDA that received traditional (full) approval based on urinary oxalate as a surrogate for clinical manifestations of PH1; nedosiran holds orphan drug designation for primary hyperoxaluria, and no accelerated approval, advisory committee, or REMS applied.

citations.quote: During discussions of the design of the trial, the Agency expressed a willingness to accept a substantial change in urinary oxalate in patients with high baseline levels as a basis for full approval.
